key.name: dock-autohide
key.description: Hide the dock on the desktop until the pointer brings it back. The dock stays visible in the overview.

key.name: dock-pressure-to-activate
key.description: Require a press against the bottom edge before showing the hidden dock. When this is off, moving into the dock area shows it.

key.name: dock-autohide-in-fullscreen
key.description: Allow the hidden dock to be revealed while a window is fullscreen on the primary monitor. When this is off, the dock stays hidden in that case.

key.name: dock-autohide-urgent
key.summary: Show the dock for an urgent notification
key.description: Reveal the dock when a notification arrives with critical urgency, and keep it shown until that notification is dismissed.

key.name: dock-animation-duration
key.description: How long the dock takes to show and hide, in milliseconds.

key.name: dock-hide-timeout
key.description: How long the pointer must stay away from the dock before it hides, in milliseconds.

key.name: dock-pressure-threshold
key.description: How far the pointer must press against the bottom edge, in pixels, before the dock is shown. Used when pressure to activate is on.

key.name: dock-click-left
key.summary: Left click on a dock icon
key.description: What a left click on a dock app icon will do.

key.name: dock-click-middle
key.summary: Middle click on a dock icon
key.description: What a middle click, the scroll-wheel button, on a dock app icon will do.

key.name: dock-orientation
key.description: Whether the dock sits at the top or the bottom of the screen. The extension stores this value and does not apply it yet.

key.name: panel-icons
key.description: Role-to-label map of the panel status area, written by the extension when it enables. Preferences reads this because it cannot import the shell.

key.name: monitor-panels
key.description: Maps a monitor connector to that monitor's panel settings. Each entry may contain panel-enabled (boolean) and icons (a dictionary of icon id to boolean). Missing monitors and icons stay enabled. panel-enabled shows the top bar. Each icon chooses whether that button is shown on the bar.
